text.en: In a village where water is scarce, even a small act of kindness can matter.

Thanneer is a short story by Kandharvan about the water crisis in small villages, which has become a serious problem of daily life. Literature has stressed the need of water since ancient times, and the story brings out how the shortage affects ordinary people.
The story begins with a harsh sun and makes us feel the thirst of the village. It teaches that water is precious, that we should share it and care for sources.
Notice how a short story (சிறுகதை) builds a mood through description of the weather and place. Learn the words தண்ணீர், வறட்சி (drought), சிற்றூர் (small village) and நெருக்கடி (crisis).
